acceptanceCriteria: A Tasks source archive from a commit containing the opt-in pack deriver builds its advertised binary offline with the documented command.
Retain exact commit/tree provenance, notices and licensing boundaries for every included dependency.
A regression exercises the actual exported archive and catches omitted transitive packages; keep Core from linking Tasks mutation code.
body:
Observed while qualifying CAL-V0-026 on S8 PR #312, head 40f7d7e9b4c65da5660e42261c1c6e4c4ae31fe8. internal/tasks/scopes/derive.go imports internal/contextindex and internal/runtimeenv for the owner-approved CAL-V0-022 in-process pack integration. internal/companionrelease/export.go tasksExportPrefixes includes only cmd/corvint-tasks/ and internal/tasks/, while companionrelease.go advertises a standalone source archive rebuild. The exported subset therefore omits required Core packages. Independent CAL26 review confirmed this dependency-closure defect. This is a packaging/release blocker separate from the lease-lock requirement; do not infer standalone source rebuild from a boundary-test pass.

2026-09-28 reviewed local outcome: Local implementation 66a2cd6f is independently reviewed on codex/tasks-archive-fix; dependency base e7842a77 includes existing PR #315, CEM 586b0c2074f41d03edbc16d3bae00d871615348c. Actual 428-file source archive builds offline; deleting a transitive dependency causes the negative control to fail. Provenance and licensing checks, Core-to-Tasks boundary controls, vet, locators and all four keyed checks PASS; strict dogfood check PASS. Archive sha256 e6edadf42ed53fbc1ee4f6bee8249c53a0d21b8b430476df1f66ce0d975bffb1. Integration verified: prerequisite PR #315 and fix PR #322 are merged. PR #322 head ae7cd931c8c3d2e5977def92d65d52c635e0b13b is on origin/main through merge f0bcf14364e13885e431146f093ca2e4e726b43a; all 11 CI checks PASS. All three ticket criteria are supported by the retained archive proof and independent review. Separate full companion release qualification is NOT_RUN and outside this bug ticket. Completion evidence bundle SHA256 1fd0724c9e0f52c79a9ec71ce821a198323247b35df74d4c66fe3e19eedf2622.

completion.reason: All three acceptance criteria verified by actual offline exported-archive build, negative control, exact Git-byte/license provenance, and Core-to-Tasks boundary checks; independently reviewed. Prerequisite PR #315 and fix PR #322 merged; all 11 PR #322 CI checks PASS; reviewed head ae7cd931c8c3d2e5977def92d65d52c635e0b13b is ancestor of origin/main via f0bcf14364e13885e431146f093ca2e4e726b43a. Explicit evidenced manual disposition because installed runtime has no submit/gate-run/complete surface; native gate execution is NOT_OBSERVED. Full companion release qualification remains NOT_RUN outside this ticket. Evidence bundle: /private/tmp/corvint-bugfix-20260928/V1-0456-merged-evidence.json.

title: Preserve Tasks source-archive rebuild after opt-in Core pack derivation
